surface_geometry.definition: In BHSM, surface topography includes gravitational spacetime geometry; it is not limited to a material skin or a separate membrane.
surface_geometry.summary: When observations and the admitted model support a gravitational origin, the inferred exterior is interpreted as BHSM spacetime-side surface topography. One Einstein/GHY exterior optical response is counted once; no additional force or mass is introduced and no non-GR residual is required.
surface_geometry.evidence_scope: This is a model-conditional interpretation. A fitted or nonrejected light curve alone does not validate a gravitational origin, uniquely verify BHSM or identify a black hole.
surface_geometry.unidentified_scope: A unique microscopic interface shape, distinct dynamical surface response, hard-isolation state, horizon and core process require additional physical maps and evidence.
